value.rationale: The precise seven-fractional-bit grid corresponds to a motivated low-width representation of the source example, whose authors specifically report discrepant 16-bit trajectories. The complete basin inventory quantifies how encoding the very parameter selected in their chaotic simulation changes all recurrent periods and divides the largest basin; 5122 changed edges are directly relevant to evaluating digital recurrence robustness. The claim is exact, self-contained, and full-domain at that scale, not a derived restatement of generic finite-state eventual periodicity.
